categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four treatment areas: medical aesthetics and wound care, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and anti-adhesion and hemostasis products. The company develops, manufactures, and sells biomedicine products including hyaluronic acid, epidermal growth factor, chitosan, collagen, intraocular lenses, ophthalmic implants, and orthokeratology lenses. It also engages in medical device sales and pharmaceutical technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced biotechnologies such as gene engineering for epidermal growth factor production, multiple cross-linking technologies for hyaluronic acid products including organic cross-linking, and proprietary manufacturing processes for intraocular lenses including injection molding and classic lathe-cutting. It also develops medical devices using multi-phase controlled radiofrequency and vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) technologies. The company holds numerous patents and proprietary technologies in biomedicine and medical devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals (especially tertiary and secondary hospitals), medical aesthetic institutions, ophthalmic clinics, and distributors across China and internationally. The company serves end markets in medical aesthetics, ophthalmology (cataract surgery, myopia control, refractive correction), orthopedics (osteoarthritis treatment), and surgical anti-adhesion. It also supplies global customers in over 70 countries through its subsidiaries, particularly in ophthalmic materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant presence in major domestic markets including Shanghai, Beijing, Guangdong, and others. It also has international operations and subsidiaries in the United States, United Kingdom, France, Israel, Singapore, and Hong Kong, serving global markets in Europe, North America, and Asia. Overseas subsidiaries contribute to research, manufacturing, and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haohai Biotech operates across the supply chain from upstream raw material production (e.g., hyaluronic acid and chitosan raw materials), midstream product development and manufacturing (biomedical products, medical devices), to downstream sales and distribution to hospitals and medical institutions. It integrates R&D, production, and sales, with subsidiaries covering raw material production, product manufacturing, and marketing channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in medical aesthetics, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and surgical materials. It invests heavily in R&D (~8.86% of revenue), focusing on new product development such as organic cross-linked hyaluronic acid, advanced intraocular lenses (multifocal, EDOF, trifocal), high oxygen-permeable orthokeratology lenses, and novel injectable biomaterials. It maintains global R&D platforms and collaborates with universities and research institutes to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, including hyaluronic acid products, intraocular lenses, ophthalmic materials, and orthopedic injectables. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales to hospitals and distributors with an extensive dealer network. It also earns income from licensing and investment returns from subsidiaries and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Haohai Biotech is a leading domestic player in biomedicine and medical devices in China, holding top market shares in ophthalmic viscoelastic devices, orthopedic joint injections, and surgical anti-adhesion materials. It competes with other Chinese and international biomedical companies in medical aesthetics and ophthalmology. The company is recognized for its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and integrated supply chain, positioning it as a domestic leader and internationally recognized brand.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.7 billion, a 1.64% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 420 million. It maintains a stable asset base of over RMB 7.1 billion and net assets of RMB 5.6 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with continuous investment in R&D and capacity expansion. It has a diversified shareholder base and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines covering multiple therapeutic areas, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. Its products, such as the organic cross-linked hyaluronic acid and innovative intraocular lenses, offer superior safety, efficacy, and clinical outcomes. The integrated supply chain and extensive sales network enable reliable product quality and market penetration. The company also focuses on regulatory compliance and sustainable innovation to maintain competitive advantage.
